scope: Bedrijfsgeheugen Powerhouse / GitHub / Supabase / BRAIN delivery / completion supervision

incident.summary: Canonical truth-closure release #1911 initially could not be safely merged because the Supabase migration version collided with an existing migration and BRAIN exposed multiple independent backend-contract failures during exact-head verification.
symptoms: BRAIN public diagnostics contract rejected raw backend diagnostics persistence
after migration rename, regression test still referenced the old migration filename
materiality contract required explicit CURRENT_DEFECT and CURRENT_EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY classifications
production migration ledger later proved a different already-applied canonical version than the temporary repository version

root_causes.cause: Repository migration identity and already-applied production ledger identity diverged during concurrent recovery. The correct authority was the production ledger; replaying DDL or weakening duplicate-version validation would have created a second truth.
An exact-file regression test retained the pre-rename migration path, so BRAIN failed after the migration itself had been corrected.
The content-loop persisted raw internal error/step diagnostics into shared result state instead of retaining detailed diagnostics only in server logging and exposing a stable generic code.
The SQL read model was semantically fail-closed but did not explicitly encode the same canonical material classifications already defined by the truth classifier, causing contract mismatch.

fixes: kept duplicate migration validation fail-closed; never loosened the validator
moved backend/provider diagnostics to server logs and persisted/returned CONTENT_LOOP_INTERNAL_ERROR only
updated the regression test to follow the renamed canonical migration file
aligned SQL materiality semantics with CURRENT_DEFECT, CURRENT_EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY and EVIDENCE_MISSING while preserving unknown-state fail-closed behavior
merged #1911 only after exact-head Required, BRAIN, Supabase Preview/Security, RLS, CodeQL and trust/quality gates were terminal green
used #1921 to reconcile repository migration identity to the already-proven production ledger identity 20260917123749 without replaying production DDL

truth_semantics.rule: A verified release may be LIVE_VERIFIED while the broader Completion Supervisor remains BLOCKED by unrelated material obligations. Never promote whole-system status from a narrower release proof.

reusable_diagnostic_sequence: read current PR head and current protected main before every release decision
if Supabase preview fails, distinguish migration identity/version collision from SQL semantic failure
if BRAIN fails, inspect the exact failing assertion and changed lane before modifying tests or product code
after a migration rename, search all exact path references before rerunning CI
compare SQL materiality labels with the canonical truth-classifier constants
require fresh exact-head Required/BRAIN/security/trust evidence after every head movement
after merge, read production migration ledger, live Edge Function version and material-claims view
reconcile repository lineage to production truth without replaying already-applied DDL
write release evidence into the existing Completion Supervisor obligation while preserving unrelated blockers
